structural_change: s81dv_idxtxga (TOPK TX y FB child, STW-S81c-TOK4 10-22): column A of the TX score store (banks 0-4, 5 x ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256) as its own hardened tile with its own clock root, so the y parent spans only the other half with its root (v/w: one root over 626 x 562 um). Same per-bank structure as x (WDL write landing, RIL read landing, RDL capture, macro_pin_flops anchors), bank-select copies local. RTL 20f1e4be0, lockstep y == reference LPX=2. r1: OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE=^p (gate ODB-0359: every input port lands directly in a flop that also drives a macro pin, so io_flop_at_pins tried to move a macro_pin_flops FIRM anchor; inputs keep the macro-pin anchor, the timing-critical side (v/w r_ce_in -65.8); the port side is a flop-to-flop crossing from the parent with no logic). r2 (STW-S81c-TOK5 10-22): route s81dv_idxtxga-ga-df0b64d73 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP TT post-CTS -506 ps / 1461 ep: worst reg->out g_bsl.bsk1[0] -> p[1] (comb 5-bank AND-OR to the pin under a 0.6 T output budget, 435 ps wire); RTL POUT=1 registers p in the child (pin flop) and the parent ORs pa|pb combinationally (rd edge unchanged, 0 cycles).
